findings.current: “Heh heh. This old man has finally found the place where he’ll die.”
findings.defect: The draft makes Flame Tiger say that he himself has found a place to die, but he is taunting Jeok Cheongang by saying that Jeok has found his place of death.
findings.rationale: 늙은이 refers to the old man Flame Tiger is addressing, as confirmed by Jeok Cheongang’s reply that this is a place where he will kill rather than die.
findings.replacement: “Heh heh. Looks like you’ve finally found a place to die, old man.”

findings.current: “I arrived much sooner than I’d heard, but that doesn’t change anything.”
findings.defect: The subject is reversed. Flame Tiger is commenting that Jeok Cheongang and Taekyung arrived sooner than expected, not that Flame Tiger himself arrived sooner.
findings.rationale: The following narration explicitly has Taekyung wonder how Flame Tiger received information about their movements so quickly.
findings.replacement: “You arrived much sooner than I’d heard… but that changes nothing.”
findings.source: “들은 것보다 훨씬 빨리 오긴 했지만…… 그래 봤자 달라지는 건 없지.”

findings.current: At the same time, fist force gathered around his rough, rock-hard fists.
findings.defect: The source describes fist force forming around one fist, but the draft changes it to both fists.
findings.rationale: 주먹 and 맺힌다 are singular here, matching the single fist attack that follows.
findings.replacement: At the same time, fist force gathered around his rough, rock-hard fist.
findings.source: 동시에 바위처럼 거칠고 단단해 보이는 그의 주먹에 권강(拳强)이 맺힌다.

findings.current: “That’s right. I am Jeok Cheongang, the Fire King and the eighteenth successor of the Fire Gate Clan.”
findings.defect: The draft drops the generational meaning of 십팔 대, making Jeok Cheongang merely the eighteenth successor rather than the successor of the clan’s eighteenth generation.
findings.rationale: 십팔 대 identifies his place in the Fire Gate Clan’s generational lineage, a meaningful statement of succession and hierarchy.
findings.replacement: “That’s right. I am Jeok Cheongang, the Fire King and the eighteenth-generation successor of the Fire Gate Clan.”
findings.source: “그래. 노부가 바로 열화문의 십팔 대 계승자, 화왕 적천강이니라.”

findings.current: The next moment, as though he had understood those words, Han Su’s figure shot forward at blinding speed.
findings.defect: “Shot forward” indicates movement toward the direction Han Su is facing and can read as a charge toward Jeok Cheongang and Taekyung, while the next scene establishes that he fled from them. The source specifies rapid movement but does not add this contradictory direction.
findings.rationale: The immediately following scene depicts Han Su fleeing at full speed with the two pursuers closing from behind.
findings.replacement: The next moment, as though he had understood those words, Han Su’s figure shot away at blinding speed.
findings.source: 다음 순간, 마치 그 말을 알아들은 것처럼 한수의 신형이 눈부신 속도로 쏘아졌다.

findings.current: “There they are! Fire King, that damned old man and the young brat killed Flame Tiger!”
findings.defect: The comma makes “Fire King” read as a separate person being addressed or as the first member of a three-person list. Han Su is identifying the damned old man as the Fire King and accusing that old man and the young man.
findings.rationale: 화왕 identifies 저 쳐 죽일 늙은이; Han Su is pointing out two killers, Jeok Cheongang and Taekyung, not addressing the Fire King or naming three people.
findings.replacement: “There they are! The Fire King—that goddamn old man—and the young brat killed Flame Tiger!”
findings.source: “저놈들이오! 화왕, 저 쳐 죽일 늙은이와 어린놈이 염호를 죽였소!”

summary: The draft contains three critical subject or direction errors, plus localized quantity, lineage, and dialogue-clarity issues.
